capabilities.name: Multi-source discovery engine
capabilities.summary: Pulls candidate records from every source the plan unlocks and deduplicates them into one row per real-world entity.
delivers: Business discovery across Places, Yelp, OSM and state filings
Property discovery across assessor, permit and deed records
Per-source rate limiting and backoff
Retention ceilings enforced per source contract

capabilities.name: Identity resolution + spiderweb expansion
capabilities.summary: Matches the same operator across sources, then walks outward through shared identifiers to find the records nobody searched for.
delivers: Deterministic matching on phone, email and standardised address
Probabilistic matching with a scored review queue
Owner-to-entity resolution via Secretary of State filings
Hop-limited expansion with confidence decay and full provenance

capabilities.name: Lead enrichment
capabilities.summary: Fills in what discovery does not carry: property detail, owner name, verified business contact.
delivers: USPS-standardised addresses with delivery-point validation
Property detail — year built, value, lot and building area, land use
Owner name and mailing address from assessor records
Business email discovery with MX and SMTP verification
Phone append with line-type classification

capabilities.name: Explainable lead scoring
capabilities.summary: A 0-100 score per lead with the contribution of every signal shown, so a rep can see why before they dial.
delivers: Per-industry weighted models
Signal-level contribution breakdown
Confidence rating from source coverage
Score decay as data ages
Basic model on Starter, full signal set from Pro up

capabilities.name: AI outreach generator
capabilities.summary: Writes the first touch and the follow-ups from the same signals that produced the score.
delivers: Cold email, SMS and voicemail scripts
Multi-step follow-up sequences with timing
Signal-grounded personalisation — the actual storm date, the actual permit
Compliance footers injected, not optional

capabilities.name: Lead delivery
capabilities.summary: Gets leads where the customer already works instead of asking them to log in.
delivers: Dashboard with saved searches
CSV export (every plan, no gate)
Daily email drop
REST API and webhooks (Elite and up)
CRM push (Pro and up)

capabilities.name: Industry module engine
capabilities.summary: Each industry is a data-defined model — signals, weights, filters and outreach angle — so a new vertical ships without a deploy.
delivers: Eight modules at launch
Per-module filter sets
Custom modules on Enterprise
Weights tunable per account from closed-won feedback

capabilities.name: Ideal customer profile
capabilities.summary: The account tells the engine what a good job looks like, and the ranking follows.
delivers: Service area by radius, ZIP list or drawn polygon
Ideal customer profile with target value range
Lead volume pacing so a month's quota is not spent in a day
Per-account signal weight overrides (Elite and up)

capabilities.name: Billing and upsell
capabilities.summary: Stripe subscriptions with metered overage, lead packs and industry unlocks.
delivers: Stripe subscriptions and metered usage
Lead packs with a best-price guarantee
Industry unlocks as subscription add-ons
Upgrade recommendation when the current plan genuinely costs more
Dunning and involuntary-churn recovery

capabilities.name: Compliance layer
capabilities.summary: Scrubbing and gating that runs whether or not the customer remembers it exists.
delivers: DNC scrub before release, re-scrubbed every 31 days
Known-litigator suppression
Account-level opt-out honoured across all channels
CAN-SPAM footer enforcement on generated email
Restricted signals gated behind an FCRA attestation
Full provenance on every field for audit

compliance.dncScrubNote: 31 days is the TCPA safe-harbour interval. A number scrubbed longer ago than that is treated as unscrubbed and withheld from release.
compliance.canSpamNote: A generated email missing any of these does not send. The template renderer rejects it rather than filling in a placeholder, because a placeholder that ships is a $53,088-per-message violation.
compliance.smsNote: Cold SMS to a mobile number without prior express written consent is not a grey area — it is the single most litigated part of the TCPA. The platform generates SMS copy only for contacts carrying a recorded consent record.

fcraBoundary.note: Signals flagged `restricted` are modelled from public and aggregate data for marketing suitability. Using them to decide who gets a policy, a loan, a job or a lease turns the output into a consumer report and the seller into a CRA. The engine withholds those signals until the account attests, and the attestation is recorded with a timestamp.

compliance.aggregateDisclosure: Any field derived from Census block-group data describes a neighbourhood, not a person, and is labelled as an area estimate everywhere it appears.

dataSubjectRights.note: CCPA/CPRA and the newer state acts give residents deletion and opt-out rights over exactly this kind of data. Building the delete path on day one costs a week; retrofitting it under a regulator's deadline costs a quarter.

outreachTemplates.subject: Storm damage check on {{lead.street}}?
We're already on {{lead.street}} on {{business.routeDay}}s
{{signal.extremeTempDays7d}} days above {{signal.tempThreshold}}° coming
Rough numbers for {{lead.street}}
Your {{lead.permitType}} permit on {{lead.street}}
Roof condition at {{lead.propertyAddress}}
Congrats on {{lead.legalEntityName}}

outreachTemplates.body: Hi {{lead.ownerFirstName}}, this is {{business.senderName}} with {{business.name}} here in {{lead.city}}. Calling about {{lead.hook}} — nothing urgent. If it's useful, I'm on {{business.phone}}. If not, no need to call back and I won't chase you. Thanks.
outreachTemplates.note: Short, names the reason, and gives an explicit out. Voicemails that do all three get returned several times more often than ones that pitch.

default.intent: reference the email, ask one question
proof — a nearby job, a photo, a number
breakup — permission to close the file

followUpSequence.note: Five touches over thirty days. Most contractors send one and conclude the leads were bad.
